claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Pregnenolone succinate is a steroid ester that at 2.5 uM is unlikely to kill cells through its annotated GABA-A negative allosteric modulation or CYP17A1 inhibition; any weak, non-selective antiproliferative effect would most plausibly reflect a physicochemical/steroidal membrane or lysosomal perturbation rather than a specific cytotoxic mechanism.
